highlights.title: Bots don't give up after a failed step
highlights.text: When a step fails or is refused, a bot tries it again, then tries another way. A step you declined isn't tried again.

highlights.title: A stuck bot says what would unblock it
highlights.text: When nothing works, a bot ends with a line that starts with Blocked: and names what would unblock it. From a team's lead, it comes to you as a question, and your answer lets the team carry on.

fixes: If a reply still ends on "I'll…" after a failed step, the bot gets one more turn. If it only promises again, a short note says it stopped.
